headline: Canary Islands receives nearly 500 million for its RIC bonds, but can only allocate 100 million
summary: The Canary Islands regional bond issue drew 1,684 applications and nearly 500 million euros in demand, against 100 million allocated, at a fixed 0.2% annual rate.
why: Regional government bonds in Spain are issued to fund public investment and are priced relative to Spanish sovereign debt. Strong demand signals investor appetite for regional Spanish paper.
